title: Zion's Victory Over the Nations
description: Many nations gather against Zion to profane her, but they do not know the thoughts and plans of the Lord. He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor. The daughter of Zion is called to rise up and thresh, with horns of iron and hooves of bronze to crush the peoples, and their unjust gain shall be devoted to the Lord of all the earth.
